hook.text: In 2021, Amsterdam unveiled the world's first 3D-printed steel bridge.

buildup.text: MX3D used wire-arc additive manufacturing, feeding steel wire into a welding torch mounted on a six-axis robotic arm.

discovery.text: The bridge embeds sensors monitoring stress, vibration, and pedestrian traffic in real time via a digital twin.

twist.text: Printing a bridge freed designers from traditional geometry.

climax.text: China has printed concrete bridges and Spain has printed footbridges.

punchline.text: A robot welded a bridge in Amsterdam that walks hold daily.
